name: read__simple_request_response
description: Locks the IM:Read code path at scenario level: peer ships ReadRequestMessage on a fresh exchange, the bridge resolves the requested paths through the dispatcher and replies with a ReportData on the same exchange. The scenario uses the empty topology so the path is unresolved and the bridge replies with an UnsupportedCluster ReportData — that's still a valid IM-contract-honoring response (envelope shape locked, status inside). Catches regressions where the bridge silently drops Read or panics on an unknown path. Fabric-scoped variants (FabricFiltered=true with two fabric indexes) stay queued — they need a topology recipe that exposes a FabricScopedReader server.
